Questions about the blindtest

Is the K-pop blindtest free?
Yes. Every mode is free. An account keeps your rank title, streak and ranked season score.
How many songs are in the pool?
4,120 songs, from the first generation of K-pop to the fifth. 79 groups have their own playlist of 11 to 18 songs.
How does scoring work?
A right answer gives 100 points. Answering in under 2 seconds adds up to 100 more. Each right answer in a row raises your combo by x0.1, up to x2. A miss resets the combo.
Does it work on my phone?
Yes. Tap to answer. The clip plays in the page, so turn your sound on.

How ranked works

A ranked run
Ten songs drawn by the server from the whole pool: 4 easy, 4 medium and 2 hard, based on how often fans get them right. 6 song rounds and 4 artist rounds, 10-second clips, no skip, no playlist choice. Everyone plays by the same rules.
Points per song
100 for a right answer, plus up to 100 for speed: full bonus under 2 seconds, nothing at 10. Then your combo multiplies it: x1.0, +0.1 for each right answer in a row, up to x2.0. A miss resets the combo. A perfect fast run is about 2,900 points.
Season score
Your season score is the total of your 5 best runs. A new run counts only if it beats your fifth best, so your score never goes down. Ties are broken by average answer speed.
Seasons and placement
A season lasts 8 weeks. When it ends you keep your rank title and XP, your season score starts again, and your first 5 runs place you. You get a badge for your final tier.
Fair play
Songs and clip timings come from the server, and answer times are measured from the moment the clip starts. You can play 15 ranked runs a day. If you quit, the run is recorded with the songs you answered.
Rank title and ranked tier
Your rank title (Trainee, Rookie, Debut, Idol, Star, Superstar, Legend) comes from all the blindtest XP you have ever earned and never goes down. Your ranked tier is for this season only.

How points work

Fandom war points
Every quiz and blindtest you play for a group adds points to its fandom: 10 for a finished quiz, +5 for a perfect score, 20 for the blindtest of the day. Ranked runs count twice. Your main fandom is set in Settings.
Player points
The XP you earned this week: quizzes, blindtests, daily streak bonuses and likes on your comments. The same XP moves your level on your passport.
Creator points
Plays and likes on the quizzes you made this week. Quizzes with a fun fact on every question get a 10% bonus.
